# BatteryLife Processed subset: CALB_0_B182, cycles 1 to 100

The cycle-capacity history of one CALB cell, extracted from the pinned BatteryLife Processed v11 release
(doi:10.5281/zenodo.19688272, `CALB.zip`, MD5 2b1006e96e0ca42765a732060f964687) by
`python scripts/prepare-batterylife-calb.py <dir> v11`. `manifest.json` records the release and file checksums.

**Licence:** MIT (`LICENSE`, from the BatteryLife repository). The CALB data were produced by the BatteryLife work.

**Cite:** Ruifeng Tan, Weixiang Hong, Jiayue Tang, Xibin Lu, Ruijun Ma, Xiang Zheng, Jia Li, Jiaqiang Huang and
Tong-Yi Zhang. "BatteryLife: A Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for Battery Life Prediction." KDD 2025.
https://doi.org/10.1145/3711896.3737372

The demo page and `scripts/run-battery-case.mjs` read `battery-history.json`.
